name: Freezing Ray
primary:
A ray of cold that gradually freezes its target.
A beam to the aim point hits everyone along it. In instant mode it keeps firing while held. Effects:
• Cold 60: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
self_description:
On you:
• Cold 120: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
